assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production fantasy game interface corner fitting, square image, front-facing orthographic. Inside the medallion, four golden ears of wheat radiate from a small central vermilion cabochon in a symmetrical cross, pointing up, down, left and right, all four identical. No scenery, no words, no lettering, no numbers, no crowns, no lions, no stars, no characters, no frame around the entire image, no shadow on the background.
